groups.title: Separate calculation from presentation
groups.reason: The same function calculates the total and formats its display string. Extracting the calculation creates a reusable, directly testable boundary.
groups.benefit: Callers can work with integer cents without parsing a formatted currency string. This is a structural improvement, not a measured speedup.
groups.tradeoffs: The extra public function should be retained only if reuse or focused tests justify the boundary. Preserve the current rounding and formatting behavior.

checks.description: Compare formatted totals for zero, multiple items and fractional-cent inputs before accepting.
